_comment: HAND-AUTHORED and NOT generated. The Home page is virtual: no clrType, no documents, no
collection. HomeActions.OnLoadAsync scaffolds the object per request, fills these values and
sets Breadcrumb -- which is what the generic page renders as its <h2> title, replacing the
tabs and groups are both empty on purpose: attributes then land in one unheaded card, so the
breadcrumb is the only heading on the page and there is no double title.
The accounts grid is the my-accounts query of MyAccountRow, named below. Read/Home is granted
to BOTH well-known roles -- anonymous visitors get the page and the welcome text; the grid
itself needs Query/MyAccountRow, which only the authenticated role holds, so it simply does

attributes.name: Title
attributes._comment: Feeds the breadcrumb template only; never drawn as a row. HomeActions sets Breadcrumb directly as well, so this is the fallback path rather than the primary one.
